notes.title: Price revealed - 6.99 USD/6.99 EUR!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

You have been asking for the price of the game for a while now so, here it is!

Numb is going to cost 6.99 USD/6.99 EUR!

Release on September 27th!

notes.title: Giveaway!
notes.content:
